name: ATPase H+ transporting V1 subunit B2

function.text: ATP6V1B2 encodes v-type proton ATPase subunit B, brain isoform. Annotated molecular activities include proton transmembrane transporter activity and proton-transporting ATPase activity, rotational mechanism. It participates in vacuolar acidification and ATP metabolic process.
